nextStoryContext: US-005 is the interactive/tmux mode (createTmuxSession path). launcher.ts already exports launchClaude with injectable SpawnAdapter. US-005 will likely add a launchInteractive(opts) or createTmuxSession function — it should NOT touch launchClaude/print mode. The SpawnAdapter interface is in src/retry/launcher.ts. Check if US-005 needs a new entry point in index.ts (e.g. cam run or wired inside existing cam run) or a separate cam command.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: Bun.spawn(argv, { stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' }) returns Subprocess with .stdout: ReadableStream, .stderr: ReadableStream, .exited: Promise<number>. new Response(proc.stdout).text() is valid (equivalent to proc.stdout.text()). proc.exited resolves to exit code as number. Implementation matches API.
